g.title: application
g.text: 02 | APPLY THE NETWORK AND SOLVE A MAP

g.title: cluster_network
g.text: 1 RESTORE AND RUN THE TRAINED NETWORK

g.title: cluster_planner
g.text: 2 USE NEURAL GUIDANCE TO SEARCH FOR A COMPLETE PATH

g.title: provided
g.text: PNG / JPEG occupancy image + start (x,y) + goal (x,y)
No A* labels or training required for this query

g.title: grid
g.text: GridMap builds clearance mask, validates endpoints,
and supplies free samples + edge collision checks;
other helpers prepare normalized network inputs

g.title: wrapper
g.text: GNGWrapper: instantiate UNet, load weights, eval mode
classify_path_points(): build start / goal / map channels;
pad + normalize; run model; crop output;
return positive coordinates, mask and probabilities

g.title: neural
g.text: rejects guidance pixels that violate clearance;
mixes neural and global free-space samples
(default neural rate: 0.5; empty guidance: global sampling)

g.title: config
g.text: Also provides runtime helpers to plan.py

g.title: guidance
g.text: Candidate pixel coordinates + binary mask + probabilities
This is guidance; it may be disconnected

g.title: guidance->neural
g.text: candidate coordinates; planner keeps valid ones

g.title: rrt
g.text: RRTStar2D: expand tree; choose parents; rewire;
planning() returns a path or an empty array

g.title: plan
g.text: Reads CLI options; creates GridMap, GNGWrapper and NRRTStarGNG2D;
calls planner.planning(); checks final path; draws and exports results

g.title: neural->plan
g.text: planner instantiated here; planning() returns ordered path

g.title: results
g.text: plan.png: occupancy map + guidance + resulting path
result.json: success, path length, timing and settings
If no path is found: diagnostic image / JSON and an empty path

g.title: legend
g.text: Solid teal: data, predictions, weights or results flow to the receiving file.
Dashed purple: code is instantiated / used by the receiver, or a base class contributes through inheritance.
Blue: Python code. Gold: inputs / intermediate data. Green: final outputs.
plan.py orchestrates the entire process; its box is placed at the export stage to show contributions flowing toward the caller.
This chart shows neural guidance enabled. A* and eval_unet.py do not run when solving a provided map.
